title: A comprehensive overview of monkeypox virus disease.
abstract: Monkeypox (mpox), caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), re-emerged as a major global public health concern in 2022, resulting in widespread transmission beyond traditionally endemic regions. As of March 2026, 181,164 confirmed cases and 492 deaths had been reported across 144 countries globally. The unprecedented geographic spread of the outbreak highlighted important knowledge gaps in disease surveillance, prevention, and control. Given the ongoing global circulation of MPXV and the risk of future outbreaks, this review provides a comprehensive synthesis of current evidence on MPXV and mpox. The literature, surveillance data, and public health reports available up to March 2026 were systematically reviewed and synthesized. The review comprehensively assesses viral biology, genetic diversity, epidemiology, transmission dynamics, clinical manifestations, pathogenesis, laboratory diagnosis, infection during pregnancy, host immune responses, immune evasion mechanisms, therapeutic interventions, and prevention strategies. Globally, the decline in public immunity following the cessation of routine smallpox vaccination, together with ongoing viral evolution, may have contributed to the resurgence of mpox. Advances in genomic surveillance, diagnostics, and public health preparedness have strengthened outbreak response; however, important gaps remain in understanding long-term immunity and optimal treatment strategies. This review summarizes current evidence on MPXV and mpox and highlights priorities for future research and public health interventions. Suspect mpox in patients presenting with an unexplained rash, fever, and lymphadenopathy. The incubation period typically ranges from 7–14 days (up to 21 days). Immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV, pregnant women, and children are at increased risk of severe disease and complications. RT-PCR testing of lesion-derived specimens remains the diagnostic gold standard for confirmation of mpox infection. Genomic sequencing may support clade identification and outbreak surveillance.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 猴痘(猴痘)由猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起,于2022年重新成为全球主要公共卫生问题,导致猴痘病例在传统流行地区以外广泛传播。本综述聚焦于猴痘病毒(MPXV)的系统发育分支和猴痘(猴痘)疾病,特别关注病毒生物学、遗传多样性、传播、流行病学动态、临床表现、诊断、实验室检测、妊娠期间感染、血清流行率、免疫逃逸机制、治疗干预措施和预防策略。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 截至2026年3月,所有可用的文献、流行病学数据和公共卫生报告均被系统地回顾和综合。本综述包括对病变部位样本进行RT-PCR检测作为确认猴痘(猴痘)感染的诊断金标准,并且基因组测序可能有助于确定病毒的系统发育分支和流行病学特征。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 截至2026年3月,全球144个国家共报告了181,164例确诊病例和492例死亡病例。免疫功能低下者、HIV感染者、孕妇和儿童更容易出现严重疾病和并发症。猴痘(暴发)的前所未有的地理扩散凸显了在疾病流行病学、预防和控制方面的知识空白。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 常规天花疫苗接种停止后公众免疫力的下降,加上病毒持续的进化,可能促成了猴痘(猴痘)的再次暴发。在抗病毒药物、诊断技术和公共卫生准备方面的进展加强了猴痘(暴发)的应对能力;然而,对长期免疫力和最佳预防策略的理解仍存在重要空白。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 本综述总结了猴痘病毒(MPXV)和猴痘(猴痘)的当前证据,并突出了未来研究和公共卫生干预的重点。本综述提供了关于猴痘病毒(MPXV)和猴痘(猴痘)的当前证据的全面总结,强调了改善流行病学、预防和控制策略的必要性。

title_zh: 猴痘病毒病的全面综述。
source_body_en: Monkeypox (mpox), caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), re-emerged as a major global public health concern in 2022, resulting in widespread transmission beyond traditionally endemic regions. As of March 2026, 181,164 confirmed cases and 492 deaths had been reported across 144 countries globally. The unprecedented geographic spread of the outbreak highlighted important knowledge gaps in disease surveillance, prevention, and control. Given the ongoing global circulation of MPXV and the risk of future outbreaks, this review provides a comprehensive synthesis of current evidence on MPXV and mpox. The literature, surveillance data, and public health reports available up to March 2026 were systematically reviewed and synthesized. The review comprehensively assesses viral biology, genetic diversity, epidemiology, transmission dynamics, clinical manifestations, pathogenesis, laboratory diagnosis, infection during pregnancy, host immune responses, immune evasion mechanisms, therapeutic interventions, and prevention strategies. Globally, the decline in public immunity following the cessation of routine smallpox vaccination, together with ongoing viral evolution, may have contributed to the resurgence of mpox. Advances in genomic surveillance, diagnostics, and public health preparedness have strengthened outbreak response; however, important gaps remain in understanding long-term immunity and optimal treatment strategies. This review summarizes current evidence on MPXV and mpox and highlights priorities for future research and public health interventions. Suspect mpox in patients presenting with an unexplained rash, fever, and lymphadenopathy. The incubation period typically ranges from 7–14 days (up to 21 days). Immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV, pregnant women, and children are at increased risk of severe disease and complications. RT-PCR testing of lesion-derived specimens remains the diagnostic gold standard for confirmation of mpox infection. Genomic sequencing may support clade identification and outbreak surveillance.

title: Smallpox Vaccine Elicits CD8 + T Cell Immunity Persisting Over Four Decades with Cross-Recognition of Monkeypox Virus
abstract: Abstract Monkeypox, caused by MPXV, has become a global public health concern; however, the T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination remains unclear. In this study, we screened the immunogenicity of 21 predicted MPXV epitopes and compared immune responses between young and elderly groups. Two immunogenic CD8+ T-cell epitopes, M15 and M17, were identified, both of which effectively stimulated specific immune responses, with significantly stronger responses observed in the young group. Notably, this study provides the first evidence that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes the MPXV epitopes M15 and M17 and remains detectable for more than four decades after vaccination, as demonstrated in vaccinated individuals aged 53–75. These findings provide experimental evidence for understanding the cross-protective mechanisms of the smallpox vaccine and informing monkeypox vaccine development.

In this study, we screened the immunogenicity of 21 predicted MPXV epitopes and compared immune responses between young and elderly groups. Two immunogenic CD8+ T-cell epitopes, M15 and M17, were identified, both of which effectively stimulated specific immune responses, with significantly stronger responses observed in the young group. Notably, this study provides the first evidence that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes the MPXV epitopes M15 and M17 and remains detectable for more than four decades after vaccination, as demonstrated in vaccinated individuals aged 53–75. These findings provide experimental evidence for understanding the cross-protective mechanisms of the smallpox vaccine and informing monkeypox vaccine development.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination, as monkeypox has become a global public health concern and the long-term immune response to MPXV after smallpox vaccination remains unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study screened the immunogenicity of 21 predicted MPXV epitopes and compared immune responses between young and elderly groups to assess the persistence and strength of CD8+ T-cell immunity.
analysis.methods: The researchers identified two immunogenic CD8+ T-cell epitopes, M15 and M17, and evaluated their ability to stimulate specific immune responses, comparing the results between young and elderly participants.
analysis.main_results: The study found that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes MPXV epitopes M15 and M17 and remains detectable for more than four decades after vaccination, as shown in individuals aged 53–75.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings offer experimental evidence for the cross-protective mechanisms of the smallpox vaccine against MPXV, highlighting its potential role in informing monkeypox vaccine development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results contribute to understanding the long-term immune protection provided by smallpox vaccination against monkeypox, which could guide public health strategies for disease prevention and control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study provides the first evidence of long-term CD8+ T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination, but it is limited to a specific age group and does not account for broader population variability.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination, as monkeypox has become a global public health concern. The researchers screened the immunogenicity of 21 predicted MPXV epitopes and compared immune responses between young and elderly groups. They identified two CD8+ T-cell epitopes, M15 and M17, which effectively stimulated immune responses, with stronger responses observed in the young group. Notably, the study provides the first evidence that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes MPXV epitopes and persists for over four decades, as demonstrated in individuals aged 53–75. These findings offer experimental evidence for the cross-protective mechanisms of the smallpox vaccine against MPXV, which could inform future vaccine development. However, the study is limited to a specific age group and does not account for broader population variability, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨天花疫苗接种后针对猴痘病毒(MPXV)的T细胞免疫,因为猴痘已成为全球公共卫生问题,而天花疫苗接种后对MPXV的长期作用仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究筛选了21个预测的MPXV表位的免疫原性,并比较了年轻组和老年组之间的免疫应答,以评估CD8+ T细胞免疫的持续性和强度。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员鉴定了两个具有免疫原性的CD8+ T细胞表位M15和M17,并评估了它们激活特定免疫应答的能力,比较了年轻和老年参与者的实验结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究发现,天花病毒疫苗接种诱导的CD8+ T细胞免疫可交叉识别猴痘病毒(MPXV)表位M15和M17,并且在疫苗接种感染后仍可检测超过四十年,如53至75岁个体所示。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为天花病毒疫苗对MPXV的交叉保护机制提供了实验依据,突显了其在猴痘病毒疫苗开发中的潜在作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于理解天花疫苗疫苗接种对猴痘提供的长期免疫保护,这可能为疾病预防和控制的公共卫生策略提供指导。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究提供了首次关于在天花疫苗接种后对猴痘病毒(MPXV)产生长期CD8+ T细胞免疫的证据,但其结果仅限于特定年龄组,未能考虑更广泛的人群变异性。

abstract_zh: 摘要 猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起的猴痘已成为全球公共卫生问题;然而,接种天花病毒疫苗后对MPXV的T细胞免疫仍不清楚。本研究筛选了21个预测的MPXV表位的免疫原性,并比较了年轻组和老年组之间的免疫应答。鉴定出两个具有免疫原性的CD8+ T细胞表位M15和M17,它们都能有效激活特定的免疫应答,年轻组的反应显著更强。值得注意的是,本研究首次提供了证据,表明天花病毒疫苗可诱导针对MPXV表位M15和M17的交叉识别的CD8+ T细胞免疫,并且在接种天花病毒疫苗后超过四十年仍可检测到,如53-75岁接种者所显示的。这些发现为理解天花病毒疫苗的交叉保护机制提供了实验依据,并有助于猴痘病毒疫苗的开发。

title: Panton-Valentine Leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus Skin Infection Mimicking Mpox in a Pediatric Returning Traveler.
abstract: A 4-year-old boy developed a fever followed by painful, polymorphic skin lesions after travel to Cameroon, raising suspicion for mpox. Viral testing was negative; wound culture grew Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus with additional, potentially synergistic virulence genes. This case demonstrates that the differential diagnosis of skin lesions following travel should include this increasingly recognized pathogen, prompting appropriate Panton-Valentine leucocidin testing.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to address the challenge of differentiating mpox from other infectious diseases in a pediatric traveler with skin lesions, highlighting the need for accurate diagnosis in the context of emerging pathogens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A single-case study was conducted on a 4-year-old boy who developed fever and polymorphic skin lesions after returning from Cameroon, with the focus on identifying the causative agent of his illness.
analysis.methods: The patient's clinical presentation and travel history were evaluated, and viral testing was performed on skin lesions. Wound cultures were conducted to identify bacterial pathogens, including Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus.
analysis.main_results: Viral testing was negative, and wound culture confirmed the presence of Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus, which carried additional virulence genes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted this case as a reminder that skin lesions in travelers may not always be caused by mpox, and they emphasized the importance of considering other pathogens, such as Staphylococcus aureus, in the differential diagnosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for broader differential diagnosis in cases of skin lesions following travel, particularly in regions where mpox is endemic, to avoid misdiagnosis and ensure appropriate treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-case design, which may not be representative of broader trends. However, the evidence is strong given the direct identification of the causative agent through wound culture.

analysis.summary_en: This case study describes a 4-year-old child who developed fever and polymorphic skin lesions after returning from Cameroon, initially suspected of having mpox. Viral testing was negative, and wound culture identified Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus with additional virulence genes. The authors highlight the importance of considering bacterial pathogens in the differential diagnosis of skin lesions in returning travelers, especially in regions where mpox is prevalent. The study serves as a cautionary example for clinicians to avoid misdiagnosis and to incorporate appropriate testing for Staphylococcus aureus in such cases. The evidence is strong due to the direct identification of the causative agent, but the single-case design limits generalizability. This case contributes to the understanding of diagnostic challenges in pediatric infectious diseases and emphasizes the need for targeted testing in travel-related skin infections.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决一名有皮肤病变的儿童旅行者中区分猴痘与其他传染病的挑战,强调了在新兴病原体背景下准确进行诊断诊断的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在一名4岁男孩从喀麦隆返回后出现发热和多形性皮肤病变的情况下,进行了一项单病例研究,重点在于确定其疾病的致病原因。
elements_zh.methods: 患者的临床表现和旅行史进行了评估,并对皮肤病变进行了病毒检测。进行了伤口培养以鉴定细菌病原体,包括产生潘托-瓦伦丁 leukocidin 的金黄色葡萄球菌。
elements_zh.main_results: 病毒检测结果为阴性,伤口培养确认存在携带额外毒力基因的Panton-Valentine溶白细胞素阳性金黄色葡萄球菌。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为一个提醒,即旅行者皮肤病变并不总是由猴痘引起,他们强调在鉴别诊断诊断时应考虑其他病原体,例如金黄色葡萄球菌。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在旅行后出现皮肤病变的情况下,需要更广泛的鉴别诊断诊断,特别是在猴痘流行地区,以避免误诊并确保适当的治疗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其单病例设计,可能无法代表更广泛的趋势。然而,鉴于通过伤口培养直接鉴定出病原体,证据是强有力的。

abstract_zh: 一名4岁男孩在前往喀麦隆旅行后出现发热,随后出现疼痛性、多形性皮肤病变,引发了对猴痘的怀疑。病毒检测结果为阴性;伤口培养出携带Panton-Valentine溶血素的金黄色葡萄球菌,并伴有其他可能具有协同作用的毒力基因。该病例表明,在旅行后出现皮肤病变的情况下,应将诊断纳入鉴别诊断考虑范围,以促使进行适当的Panton-Valentine溶血素检测。
summary_zh: 一名4岁男孩在前往喀麦隆旅行后出现发热,随后出现疼痛性、多形性皮肤病变,引发了对猴痘的怀疑。病毒检测结果为阴性;伤口培养出携带Panton-Valentine溶血素的金黄色葡萄球菌,并伴有其他可能具有协同作用的毒力基因。该病例表明,在旅行后出现皮肤病变的情况下,应将诊断纳入鉴别诊断考虑范围,以促使进行适当的Panton-Valentine溶血素检测。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决一名有皮肤病变的儿童旅行者中区分猴痘与其他传染病的挑战,强调了在新兴病原体背景下准确进行诊断诊断的必要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在一名4岁男孩从喀麦隆返回后出现发热和多形性皮肤病变的情况下,进行了一项单病例研究,重点在于确定其疾病的致病原因。
analysis_zh.methods: 患者的临床表现和旅行史进行了评估,并对皮肤病变进行了病毒检测。进行了伤口培养以鉴定细菌病原体,包括产生潘托-瓦伦丁 leukocidin 的金黄色葡萄球菌。
analysis_zh.main_results: 病毒检测结果为阴性,伤口培养确认存在携带额外毒力基因的Panton-Valentine溶白细胞素阳性金黄色葡萄球菌。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为一个提醒,即旅行者皮肤病变并不总是由猴痘引起,他们强调在鉴别诊断诊断时应考虑其他病原体,例如金黄色葡萄球菌。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在旅行后出现皮肤病变的情况下,需要更广泛的鉴别诊断诊断,特别是在猴痘流行地区,以避免误诊并确保适当的治疗。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其单病例设计,可能无法代表更广泛的趋势。然而,鉴于通过伤口培养直接鉴定出病原体,证据是强有力的。

title: Willingness to receive monkeypox vaccine and associated factors among the Ghanaian population: Findings from a nationwide survey
abstract: Abstract Background The World Health Organization recommends vaccination as an important public health intervention for controlling mpox outbreaks globally. The willingness to receive mpox vaccine and associated determinants is not fully understood in Ghana. The study therefore assessed Ghanaians' willingness to receive mpox vaccine and the associated factors using the 5 C vaccine uptake model. Methods This was a nationwide cross-sectional online survey conducted between July and October 2025 in Ghana. The study was conducted and reported in line with the STROBE Checklist for cross-sectional studies. The questionnaire was adopted and modified based on the five psychological antecedents of vaccination (confidence, complacency, constraints, calculation, and collective responsibility) and the WHO frequently asked questions on mpox. Descriptive statistics, chi-square test, and multivariate analysis were performed using Stata version 17. Results The study involved 1670 respondents, with most of them in the 18–22 years age category (761, 45.61%) and predominantly females (1296, 77.60%). Most of the respondents indicated their willingness to take the vaccine (1006, 60.24%). Vaccine confidence (p ≤ 0.001), complacency (p ≤ 0.001), and calculation (p = 0.003) were significantly associated with the willingness to receive mpox vaccine. Age 23–27 years was significantly associated with higher odds of receiving the mpox vaccine (aOR = 1.41; 95% CI: 1.11–1.80; p = 0.005). Respondents in the Bono (aOR = 2.67; 95% CI: 1.32–5.42; p = 0.007), North-East (aOR = 2.29; 95% CI: 1.11–4.76; p = 0.026), and Savannah (aOR = 1.91; 95% CI: 1.01–3.28; p = 0.048) regions were significantly associated with higher odds of receiving the mpox vaccine. High vaccine confidence (aOR = 1.75; 95% CI: 1.40–2.20; p = p ≤ 0.001) and calculation (aOR = 1.73; 95% CI: 1.35–2.06; p = p ≤ 0.001) were also associated with higher odds of willingness to receive the mpox vaccine. Conclusion Willingness to receive the mpox vaccine was high among the respondents. Tailored interventions aimed at improving vaccine confidence, complacency, and calculation are recommended. Such interventions should be age-appropriate and consider regions with low vaccine willingness rates.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估加纳人口接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿,并确定相关因素,因为目前对加纳人群中接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿及其相关决定因素的理解尚不充分。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项调查是在2025年7月至10月期间在加纳全国范围内进行的一项横断面在线调查,共涉及1670名受访者,其中大多数年龄在18–22岁之间,且以女性为主。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用Stata 17进行描述性统计、卡方检验和多变量分析。问卷是基于疫苗接种的五个心理前因(信心、轻视、限制、计算和集体责任)以及WHO关于猴痘的常见问题进行采用和修改的。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为表明受访者中对猴痘和疫苗的接受意愿较高,接受意愿与诸如疫苗的自信、自满和计算等因素存在显著关联。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为制定有针对性的干预措施提供信息,以提高疫苗的信心、轻敌和计算能力,从而增强猴痘在加纳的接种率。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究按照横断面研究的STROBE清单进行了开展和报告,这为方法学和报告提供了中等程度的信心。

title: Maternal and neonatal mpox in Nigeria: a multicentre case series highlighting diagnostic challenges, transmission pathways, and neonatal outcomes
abstract: Abstract Background Mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period is uncommon, and evidence regarding maternal clinical presentation, neonatal acquisition, and pregnancy outcomes remains limited, particularly in endemic African settings. Data on maternal–neonatal pairs infected with Clade IIb monkeypox virus (MPXV) are especially scarce. We describe the clinical characteristics, diagnostic challenges, potential transmission pathways, and outcomes of three mother–infant pairs managed at hospitals in southern Nigeria. Case presentation We conducted a retrospective multicentre case series involving three mothers with probable mpox during late pregnancy and their three neonates with laboratory-confirmed mpox managed at two tertiary teaching hospitals and one private specialist hospital in southern Nigeria. All mothers developed acute febrile illnesses during the third trimester or immediately before delivery. Two presented with characteristic vesiculopustular eruptions, whereas one experienced a self-limiting febrile illness without recognised cutaneous lesions. None underwent laboratory testing during pregnancy and were retrospectively classified as probable maternal mpox according to the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) case definition following laboratory confirmation of MPXV infection in their newborns. All three male neonates presented within the first three weeks of life with fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions. MPXV infection was confirmed by real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and varicella-zoster virus infection was excluded where tested. Two neonates had low cycle threshold values, consistent with a high viral DNA burden. All infants received supportive care. Two recovered completely, whereas one died following early hospital discharge due to financial constraints. All mothers recovered without major complications. Although the temporal relationship between parental illness and neonatal disease suggested epidemiological linkage within the household, the precise route of neonatal acquisition could not be determined because transplacental, intrapartum, and early postnatal transmission remained plausible. Conclusions This multicentre case series expands the limited evidence on maternal and neonatal mpox in a clade IIb endemic African setting and highlights the diagnostic challenges of recognising mpox during pregnancy. Our findings demonstrate a spectrum of neonatal outcomes and underscore the uncertainty surrounding neonatal acquisition. Prospective studies that incorporate comprehensive maternal, neonatal, placental, and household investigations together with viral genomic sequencing are needed to clarify transmission pathways and inform evidence-based strategies for the diagnosis, management, and prevention of mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period.

title_zh: 尼日利亚母胎猴痘在多中心病例系列中的诊断挑战、传播途径及新生儿结局
source_body_en: Abstract Background Mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period is uncommon, and evidence regarding maternal clinical presentation, neonatal acquisition, and pregnancy outcomes remains limited, particularly in endemic African settings. Data on maternal–neonatal pairs infected with Clade IIb monkeypox virus (MPXV) are especially scarce. We describe the clinical characteristics, diagnostic challenges, potential transmission pathways, and outcomes of three mother–infant pairs managed at hospitals in southern Nigeria. Case presentation We conducted a retrospective multicentre case series involving three mothers with probable mpox during late pregnancy and their three neonates with laboratory-confirmed mpox managed at two tertiary teaching hospitals and one private specialist hospital in southern Nigeria. All mothers developed acute febrile illnesses during the third trimester or immediately before delivery. Two presented with characteristic vesiculopustular eruptions, whereas one experienced a self-limiting febrile illness without recognised cutaneous lesions. None underwent laboratory testing during pregnancy and were retrospectively classified as probable maternal mpox according to the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) case definition following laboratory confirmation of MPXV infection in their newborns. All three male neonates presented within the first three weeks of life with fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions. MPXV infection was confirmed by real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and varicella-zoster virus infection was excluded where tested. Two neonates had low cycle threshold values, consistent with a high viral DNA burden. All infants received supportive care. Two recovered completely, whereas one died following early hospital discharge due to financial constraints. All mothers recovered without major complications. Although the temporal relationship between parental illness and neonatal disease suggested epidemiological linkage within the household, the precise route of neonatal acquisition could not be determined because transplacental, intrapartum, and early postnatal transmission remained plausible. Conclusions This multicentre case series expands the limited evidence on maternal and neonatal mpox in a clade IIb endemic African setting and highlights the diagnostic challenges of recognising mpox during pregnancy. Our findings demonstrate a spectrum of neonatal outcomes and underscore the uncertainty surrounding neonatal acquisition. Prospective studies that incorporate comprehensive maternal, neonatal, placental, and household investigations together with viral genomic sequencing are needed to clarify transmission pathways and inform evidence-based strategies for the diagnosis, management, and prevention of mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period.

title: A Practical Clinical Review of Recognition, Diagnosis, Initial Management, and Referral of MPOX
abstract: Mpox can present to primary care with a wide spectrum of skin and mucosal disease, ranging from a few localized lesions to disseminated or complicated infection. Contemporary presentations may lack the classical generalized rash or prominent systemic prodrome, creating diagnostic overlap with herpes simplex, varicella-zoster, syphilis, molluscum contagiosum, bacterial skin disease, and other causes of vesicular, pustular, or ulcerative lesions. Primary-care clinicians therefore have a key role in recognition before laboratory confirmation. This practical clinical review provides a frontline approach to suspicion, immediate infection-prevention measures, lesion-based PCR testing, assessment for important coinfections, severity stratification, supportive management, and timely referral. The central sequence is: suspect mpox, protect patients and staff, test appropriately, assess severity and risk, and determine safe outpatient management versus escalation of care.

title_zh: 一种猴痘病毒的临床实用回顾:识别、初步管理及转诊
source_body_en: Mpox can present to primary care with a wide spectrum of skin and mucosal disease, ranging from a few localized lesions to disseminated or complicated infection. Contemporary presentations may lack the classical generalized rash or prominent systemic prodrome, creating diagnostic overlap with herpes simplex, varicella-zoster, syphilis, molluscum contagiosum, bacterial skin disease, and other causes of vesicular, pustular, or ulcerative lesions. Primary-care clinicians therefore have a key role in recognition before laboratory confirmation. This practical clinical review provides a frontline approach to suspicion, immediate infection-prevention measures, lesion-based PCR testing, assessment for important coinfections, severity stratification, supportive management, and timely referral. The central sequence is: suspect mpox, protect patients and staff, test appropriately, assess severity and risk, and determine safe outpatient management versus escalation of care.

title: Development and evaluation of a two-tube multiplex real-time PCR assay for differential detection of Monkeypox virus clades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb
abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has caused two Public Health Emergencies of International Concern since 2022, with co-circulation of distinct clades (Ia, Ib, IIa, IIb) that differ in virulence and transmission patterns. Rapid discrimination of these clades is critical for outbreak control and clinical management. Here, we developed and validated a two-tube multiplex real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay targeting the H3L gene, designed to first distinguish clade I from clade II, followed by subtyping into clades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb in separate reactions. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity, with detection limits of 100 copies/reaction for clade Ia, 10 copies/reaction for clade Ib, 10 copies/reaction for clade IIa, and 1 copy/reaction for clade IIb using standard plasmids. Excellent specificity was confirmed by the absence of cross-reactivity with nucleic acids from other human pathogens, including vaccinia virus Tiantan strain (VTT), human adenovirus (HAdV), getah virus (GETV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), dengue virus (DENV), influenza A virus (IAV), influenza B virus (IBV), and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). The assay exhibited high repeatability, with intra-assay coefficients of variation (CVs) ranging from 0.09 to 1.88% and inter-assay CVs from 0.23 to 2.68%. Clinical evaluation using 48 skin samples from infected crab-eating monkeys or SCID mice showed 100% concordance with singleplex qPCR for clade IIb detection. For clades Ia, Ib, and IIa, clinical validation was not feasible due to sample unavailability, and their performance was analytically confirmed using recombinant plasmids. Importantly, the clade assignment of the 48 animal specimens was not confirmed by sequencing, which represents a limitation of the current study. Furthermore, these specimens were derived from animal models rather than human patients; thus, the results represent preclinical validation, and formal clinical validation in human specimens from endemic regions is warranted. This two-tube multiplex qPCR assay provides a rapid, sensitive, and reliable tool for the analytical discrimination of all four major MPXV clades, with preliminary clinical validation for clade IIb. Its ability to distinguish emerging clades makes it a valuable asset for clinical diagnosis, epidemiological surveillance, and future outbreak preparedness, although further clinical validation in endemic regions is required.

Rapid discrimination of these clades is critical for outbreak control and clinical management. Here, we developed and validated a two-tube multiplex real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay targeting the H3L gene, designed to first distinguish clade I from clade II, followed by subtyping into clades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb in separate reactions. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity, with detection limits of 100 copies/reaction for clade Ia, 10 copies/reaction for clade Ib, 10 copies/reaction for clade IIa, and 1 copy/reaction for clade IIb using standard plasmids. Excellent specificity was confirmed by the absence of cross-reactivity with nucleic acids from other human pathogens, including vaccinia virus Tiantan strain (VTT), human adenovirus (HAdV), getah virus (GETV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), dengue virus (DENV), influenza A virus (IAV), influenza B virus (IBV), and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). The assay exhibited high repeatability, with intra-assay coefficients of variation (CVs) ranging from 0.09 to 1.88% and inter-assay CVs from 0.23 to 2.68%. Clinical evaluation using 48 skin samples from infected crab-eating monkeys or SCID mice showed 100% concordance with singleplex qPCR for clade IIb detection. For clades Ia, Ib, and IIa, clinical validation was not feasible due to sample unavailability, and their performance was analytically confirmed using recombinant plasmids. Importantly, the clade assignment of the 48 animal specimens was not confirmed by sequencing, which represents a limitation of the current study. Furthermore, these specimens were derived from animal models rather than human patients; thus, the results represent preclinical validation, and formal clinical validation in human specimens from endemic regions is warranted. This two-tube multiplex qPCR assay provides a rapid, sensitive, and reliable tool for the analytical discrimination of all four major MPXV clades, with preliminary clinical validation for clade IIb. Its ability to distinguish emerging clades makes it a valuable asset for clinical diagnosis, epidemiological surveillance, and future outbreak preparedness, although further clinical validation in endemic regions is required.

The assay targets the H3L gene and is designed to first distinguish clade I from clade II, then subtype into the four major clades in separate reactions. The methods involved testing the assay's sensitivity, specificity, and repeatability using standard plasmids and clinical samples from infected crab-eating monkeys or SCID mice. The limitations include the use of animal models instead of human patients and the lack of sequencing confirmation for clade assignments.

source_body_en: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has caused two Public Health Emergencies of International Concern since 2022, with co-circulation of distinct clades (Ia, Ib, IIa, IIb) that differ in virulence and transmission patterns. Rapid discrimination of these clades is critical for outbreak control and clinical management. Here, we developed and validated a two-tube multiplex real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay targeting the H3L gene, designed to first distinguish clade I from clade II, followed by subtyping into clades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb in separate reactions. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity, with detection limits of 100 copies/reaction for clade Ia, 10 copies/reaction for clade Ib, 10 copies/reaction for clade IIa, and 1 copy/reaction for clade IIb using standard plasmids. The assay exhibited high repeatability, with intra-assay coefficients of variation (CVs) ranging from 0.09 to 1.88% and inter-assay CVs from 0.23 to 2.68%. For clades Ia, Ib, and IIa, clinical validation was not feasible due to sample unavailability, and their performance was analytically confirmed using recombinant plasmids. Importantly, the clade assignment of the 48 animal specimens was not confirmed by sequencing, which represents a limitation of the current study. Furthermore, these specimens were derived from animal models rather than human patients; thus, the results represent preclinical validation, and formal clinical validation in human specimens from endemic regions is warranted. This two-tube multiplex qPCR assay provides a rapid, sensitive, and reliable tool for the analytical discrimination of all four major MPXV clades, with preliminary clinical validation for clade IIb. Its ability to distinguish emerging clades makes it a valuable asset for clinical diagnosis, epidemiological surveillance, and future outbreak preparedness, although further clinical validation in endemic regions is required.

title: Mathematical Analysis of Mpox in HumanPopulation:TheEffectsof Vaccination Strategies
abstract: In this researchwork,afractional-ordermodelofmonkeypoxdiseasetransmissionwithinthe human population isformulatedandstudied.Theformulatedmodelincorporatestwocontrol strategies namely; vaccination and health education campaign. In model analysis, the disease free-equilibrium and basic reproduction number, are computed. The existence and unique ness of model solution using fixed point theorem have been analyzed. Meanwhile, the global stability of the model have been performed using well formulated Lyapunov function and the results showedthatthemodel isstablewhen 0 1.Inmodelsim ulations, parameter estimation using reported cases of monkeypox disease from Democratic Republic of Congo have been performed to compare the results for fractional ( = 0.5) and integer ( = 1) order derivatives. The results showed that fitting the model at = 0.5 had good results compared to when = 1.Implyingthatfractional model presented good results comparedtointeger-orderderivatives.Besides,weperformedSensitivityanalysisofthebasic reproduction number using computed partial rank correlation coefficients to investigate the impactofeachparameteronthedisease transmission.Furthermore,weperformednumerical simulation of the model to assess the impact of memory effects on the spread of monkeypox virus transmission in the population. Additionally, numerical simulation to investigate the effects of health education and vaccination was performed. Overall, the results showed that whentheefficacyoffirst-dosevaccinationwaschangedfrom75%to95%andtherateofhealth education campaign retained at 0.1thethresholdquantity 0 remainedgreaterthanunity.In contrastwhentheefficacyoffirst-dosevaccinationwaschangedfrom75%to95%andtherate ofhealtheducationcampaignchangedfrom0.1to0.9thethresholdquantity 0 wasobserved to be less than unity. The results have implication that the efficacy of first-dose vaccination must be greater than 95%andrateofhealtheducation campaignmustbegreaterthat 0.9 for the disease to eliminated in the population Monkeypox virus (MPXV) transmission remains an important public health concern, particularly in populations where vaccination coverage, disease surveillance, and access to effective preventive measures are limited. Mathematical modelling provides a valuable framework for understanding MPXV transmission dynamics and assessing the effectiveness of control interventions by describing the interactions among susceptible, vaccinated, exposed,andinfectiouspopulations.Inparticular,incorporatingfirst andsecond-dose vaccination into transmission models allows the differential protection pro videdbysuccessivevaccinedosestobeexamined,togetherwithvaccinationratesandvaccine efficacy. Parameter estimation using reported MPXV cases is essential for calibrating the modelandimproving itsabilitytodescribeobserveddiseasepatterns.Suchmodelscanalsobe used to determine key epidemiological quantities, including the basic reproduction number, and to evaluate the effects of vaccination and other interventions on disease transmission. Therefore,integratingMPXVmodelformulation,parameterestimation,andfirst-andsecond dose vaccination provides a useful mathematical framework for identifying effective control strategies and establishing conditions under which MPXV transmission can be reduced and potentially eliminated from the population.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to analyze the effects of vaccination strategies on the transmission dynamics of mpox virus within the human population, addressing the public health concern of limited vaccination coverage and preventive measures.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A fractional-order mathematical model of mpox disease transmission was formulated and studied within the human population, incorporating two control strategies: vaccination and health education campaigns. The model was analyzed using reported cases of monkeypox disease from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
analysis.methods: The model's disease-free equilibrium and basic reproduction number were computed. The existence and uniqueness of the model solution were analyzed using the fixed point theorem. Global stability was assessed using a well-formulated Lyapunov function. Sensitivity analysis of the basic reproduction number was conducted using computed partial rank correlation coefficients. Numerical simulations were performed to evaluate the impact of memory effects on disease transmission.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that the fractional-order model (with = 0.5) provided better fitting compared to the integer-order model (with = 1). When the efficacy of first-dose vaccination was increased from 75% to 95% while retaining the health education campaign rate at 0.1, the threshold quantity 0 remained greater than unity. However, when the health education campaign rate was increased from 0.1 to 0.9, the threshold quantity 0 was observed to be less than unity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the efficacy of first-dose vaccination and the rate of health education campaigns significantly influence the threshold quantity for disease elimination. The use of a fractional-order model introduces a new perspective on the dynamics of mpox virus transmission by incorporating memory effects.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results have implications for public health strategies, emphasizing the need for high vaccine efficacy and effective health education campaigns to control mpox virus transmission. Mathematical modeling can aid in determining optimal intervention strategies and conditions for disease elimination.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported cases for parameter estimation and its focus on a single geographic region. The evidence is moderate as it is based on mathematical modeling and simulations rather than empirical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a fractional-order mathematical model to analyze mpox virus transmission dynamics and the impact of vaccination and health education strategies. The model incorporates disease-free equilibrium, basic reproduction number, and global stability analysis. Results indicate that the fractional-order model provides better fitting compared to the integer-order model. Increasing vaccination efficacy to 95% while maintaining a health education campaign rate of 0.1 keeps the threshold quantity above unity, suggesting disease persistence. However, increasing the health education campaign rate to 0.9 lowers the threshold quantity below unity, indicating potential disease elimination. The study highlights the importance of high vaccine efficacy and effective health education campaigns in controlling mpox transmission. title: Analysis of Mpox intervention measures in presence of environmental transmission pathway using data from DRC
abstract: This paper develops a mathematical model for Mpox transmission dynamics accounting for disease transmission through interpersonal contact as well as from microbes infested environment. The endemic equilibrium of the model was evaluated for two cases. (1) When it is assumed that the microbes in the environment play no role in the spread of the disease, and it was shown that the endemic equilibrium is unique, exists when R 0 is greater than unity, and is globally asymptotically stable. (2) For the case when environmental microbes concentration plays a role in disease transmission, the model was shown to possibly exhibit backward bifurcation at R 0 . This indicates that lowering R 0 below 1 may not eliminate Mpox when the disease is already endemic, due to the stable endemic equilibrium. Numerical results, based on outbreak data from the DRC indicate that; (1) increased interpersonal contact has the potential of making the disease worse, (2) high isolation rate and accelerated recovery of infected individuals through any possible intervention can easily contain the disease. The results further show that environmental contamination does not substantially influence disease transmission rates. More still, it is observed that implementation of influential mitigation measures results in lower and delayed peaks of the number of infected. This is essential for healthcare systems to prepare for more emergency cases and isolation facilities when needed most especially in under resourced communities or countries. Our findings highlight the need for comprehensive interventions addressing both behavioural and environmental factors, especially in environments with limited resources.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本文开发了一个数学模型,用于分析猴痘 传播动态,考虑了通过人际接触以及微生物污染环境传播疾病的影响。本研究旨在了解环境传播在猴痘传播中的作用以及干预措施的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了一个数学模型的流行病学平衡点,分为两种情况:一种是环境微生物在疾病传播中不起作用,另一种是它们起作用。该模型基于DRC的暴发数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型被评估为两种情况:(1) 当环境微生物在疾病传播中不起作用时,以及(2) 当它们起作用时。数值结果基于DRC的暴发数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 数值结果表明,增加的人际接触可能使疾病恶化,而高隔离率和通过任何可能干预手段加速感染者康复可以控制疾病。环境污染对疾病传播率的影响不大。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,当疾病已经流行时,即使将R0降低到1以下,也可能无法消除猴痘,因为存在稳定的流行病学平衡点。研究结果强调了需要综合干预措施,同时关注行为和环境因素,尤其是在资源有限的社区中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为医疗系统提供信息,使其在资源不足的社区中准备应对更多紧急病例和隔离设施。它们还强调了在猴痘控制中同时关注行为和环境因素的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了数学模型,并且依赖于DRC的暴发数据。

title: Improving mpox identification under imbalanced data using geometric transformation and color augmentation with graph neural networks
abstract: Mpox lesion identification from skin images remains challenging because lesion appearances often overlap with other dermatological diseases and available data are commonly imbalanced. This study proposes a graph-based multi-class classification framework that combines class-balancing augmentation, convolutional neural network (CNN)-based feature extraction, and graph neural classification. Experiments were conducted on the Mpox Skin Lesion Dataset Version 2.0 using three data configurations: (i) the original imbalanced data, (ii) a balanced version generated through geometric transformation augmentation, and (iii) a balanced version generated through combined geometric transformation and color-space augmentation. Image features were extracted using eight CNN backbones (EfficientNetB4, AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, GoogleNetV3/InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and LeNet), then transformed into graphs by selecting k-nearest-neighbor candidates and retaining edges according to cosine-similarity filtering, and finally classified using graph convolutional networks (GCN) and graph attention networks (GAT). Across 48 model combinations, data balancing improved macro-level performance compared with the original imbalanced setting. The best overall result was achieved by GCN with VGG16 on the geometrically and color-augmented balanced data, reaching 92.00% accuracy, 91.55% macro F1-score, 98.81% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 93.54% macro precision, and 90.32% macro recall. The best GAT result was obtained by MobileNetV2 on the geometrically augmented balanced data, with 90.67% accuracy, 89.25% macro F1-score, 98.48% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 89.28% macro precision, and 90.27% macro recall. Although GCN showed a more consistent empirical performance trend than GAT, the difference was not statistically significant. These findings indicate that integrating balanced augmentation, CNN-derived representations, and graph learning is a promising strategy for mpox lesion identification within the scope of the present experiments; however, broader external validation and explainability-oriented analysis are still required before real-world clinical deployment.

source_body_en: Mpox lesion identification from skin images remains challenging because lesion appearances often overlap with other dermatological diseases and available data are commonly imbalanced. This study proposes a graph-based multi-class classification framework that combines class-balancing augmentation, convolutional neural network (CNN)-based feature extraction, and graph neural classification. Experiments were conducted on the Mpox Skin Lesion Dataset Version 2.0 using three data configurations: (i) the original imbalanced data, (ii) a balanced version generated through geometric transformation augmentation, and (iii) a balanced version generated through combined geometric transformation and color-space augmentation. Image features were extracted using eight CNN backbones (EfficientNetB4, AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, GoogleNetV3/InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and LeNet), then transformed into graphs by selecting k-nearest-neighbor candidates and retaining edges according to cosine-similarity filtering, and finally classified using graph convolutional networks (GCN) and graph attention networks (GAT). Across 48 model combinations, data balancing improved macro-level performance compared with the original imbalanced setting. The best overall result was achieved by GCN with VGG16 on the geometrically and color-augmented balanced data, reaching 92.00% accuracy, 91.55% macro F1-score, 98.81% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 93.54% macro precision, and 90.32% macro recall. The best GAT result was obtained by MobileNetV2 on the geometrically augmented balanced data, with 90.67% accuracy, 89.25% macro F1-score, 98.48% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 89.28% macro precision, and 90.27% macro recall. Although GCN showed a more consistent empirical performance trend than GAT, the difference was not statistically significant. These findings indicate that integrating balanced augmentation, CNN-derived representations, and graph learning is a promising strategy for mpox lesion identification within the scope of the present experiments; however, broader external validation and explainability-oriented analysis are still required before real-world clinical deployment.

title: A retrospective comparative diagnostic evaluation of three commercial qPCR kits for the diagnosis of mpox virus on an enriched sample set
abstract: Mpox virus (MPXV) is an enveloped double-stranded DNA virus belonging to the genus Orthopoxvirus within the family Poxviridae . It causes a zoonotic disease transmitted to humans through direct contact with infected animals or humans, as well as through exposure to contaminated materials. The aim of this study was to conduct a retrospective, comparative diagnostic evaluation of three commercial real-time PCR (qPCR) kits for the diagnosis of MPXV on an enriched, artificially balanced sample set that included 50% MPXV-positive samples. World Health Organization (WHO) reference molecular protocol was used as the reference comparator. A total of 300 clinical specimens, 150 of them MPXV-positive (265 skin lesion/vesicle swabs and 35 serum samples), were used in this analysis. The Bioperfectus kit correctly identified 294/300 samples, showing a sensitivity of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.93–0.99), a specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), and a Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.92–0.99), with an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.96–0.99). The VIASURE kit correctly detected 293/300 specimens, yielding a sensitivity of 0.95 (0.92–0.99), specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.95 (95% CI: 0.92–0.99 and an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.95–0.99). The Singuway kit showed the highest concordance with the reference method, correctly classifying 295/300 samples and presenting a sensitivity of 0.97 (0.94–1.00), specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.97 (95% CI: 0.94–1.00), with an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.97–1.00). This study demonstrates a good sensitivity and specificity, and strong overall agreement among the three commercial kits compared to the WHO protocol. Nevertheless, further analysis using unbiased clinical sample sets that reflect the true prevalence of MPXV-positive samples is needed for a real-world clinical performance evaluation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of three commercial qPCR kits for mpox virus (MPXV) on an enriched sample set, addressing the need for accurate and reliable diagnostic tools for mpox.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective, comparative diagnostic evaluation was conducted using 300 clinical specimens, 150 of which were MPXV-positive, to assess the performance of three commercial qPCR kits against a WHO reference protocol.
analysis.methods: The study utilized a balanced sample set of 300 specimens, including 150 MPXV-positive samples, and compared three commercial qPCR kits using the WHO reference molecular protocol as the comparator.
analysis.main_results: The Bioperfectus, VIASURE, and Singuway kits showed high sensitivity and specificity, with the Singuway kit achieving the highest overall agreement of 0.98 (95% CI: 0.97–1.00) compared to the WHO protocol.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that the three commercial qPCR kits performed well in diagnosing mpox virus, with the Singuway kit showing the highest concordance with the reference method.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that these qPCR kits can be used for accurate diagnosis of mpox, which is crucial for public health surveillance and management of mpox outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of an enriched sample set and the need for further evaluation using unbiased clinical samples to assess real-world performance.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated three commercial qPCR kits for diagnosing mpox virus, showing high sensitivity and specificity, with the Singuway kit achieving the highest overall agreement. The findings are significant for accurate diagnosis and public health management of mpox.

title_zh: 对三种商业qPCR试剂盒在富集样本集上进行回顾性比较诊断评估以检测诊断的猴痘病毒
source_body_en: Mpox virus (MPXV) is an enveloped double-stranded DNA virus belonging to the genus Orthopoxvirus within the family Poxviridae . It causes a zoonotic disease transmitted to humans through direct contact with infected animals or humans, as well as through exposure to contaminated materials. The aim of this study was to conduct a retrospective, comparative diagnostic evaluation of three commercial real-time PCR (qPCR) kits for the diagnosis of MPXV on an enriched, artificially balanced sample set that included 50% MPXV-positive samples. World Health Organization (WHO) reference molecular protocol was used as the reference comparator. A total of 300 clinical specimens, 150 of them MPXV-positive (265 skin lesion/vesicle swabs and 35 serum samples), were used in this analysis. The Bioperfectus kit correctly identified 294/300 samples, showing a sensitivity of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.93–0.99), a specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), and a Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.92–0.99), with an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.96–0.99). The VIASURE kit correctly detected 293/300 specimens, yielding a sensitivity of 0.95 (0.92–0.99), specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.95 (95% CI: 0.92–0.99 and an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.95–0.99). The Singuway kit showed the highest concordance with the reference method, correctly classifying 295/300 samples and presenting a sensitivity of 0.97 (0.94–1.00), specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.97 (95% CI: 0.94–1.00), with an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.97–1.00). This study demonstrates a good sensitivity and specificity, and strong overall agreement among the three commercial kits compared to the WHO protocol. Nevertheless, further analysis using unbiased clinical sample sets that reflect the true prevalence of MPXV-positive samples is needed for a real-world clinical performance evaluation.
abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)是一种包膜的双链DNA病毒,属于正痘病毒属,隶属于痘病毒科。它引起一种人畜共患疾病,通过直接接触感染动物或人类,以及接触受污染材料而传播给人类。本研究的目的是对三种商业化的实时PCR(qPCR)试剂盒在富集的人工平衡样本集上进行回顾性、比较性诊断评估,样本集中包括50%的MPXV阳性样本。世界卫生组织(WHO)参考分子协议被用作参考比较标准。本分析使用了300份临床标本,其中150份为MPXV阳性(265份皮肤病变/水疱拭子和35份血清样本)。Bioperfectus试剂盒正确识别了294/300样本,显示敏感性为0.96(95% CI:0.93–0.99),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.96(95% CI:0.92–0.99),总体一致性为0.98(0.96–0.99)。VIASURE试剂盒正确检测了293/300样本,敏感性为0.95(0.92–0.99),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.95(95% CI:0.92–0.99),总体一致性为0.98(0.95–0.99)。Singuway试剂盒与参考方法的一致性最高,正确分类了295/300样本,敏感性为0.97(0.94–1.00),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.97(95% CI:0.94–1.00),总体一致性为0.98(0.97–1.00)。本研究表明,三种商业试剂盒与WHO协议相比具有良好的敏感性和特异性,以及强大的总体一致性。然而,为了进行真实世界的临床性能评估,还需要使用反映MPXV阳性样本真实情况的无偏倚临床样本集进行进一步分析。
summary_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)是一种包膜的双链DNA病毒,属于正痘病毒属,隶属于痘病毒科。它引起一种人畜共患疾病,通过直接接触感染动物或人类,以及接触受污染材料而传播给人类。本研究的目的是对三种商业化的实时PCR(qPCR)试剂盒在富集的人工平衡样本集上进行回顾性、比较性诊断评估,样本集中包括50%的MPXV阳性样本。世界卫生组织(WHO)参考分子协议被用作参考比较标准。本分析使用了300份临床标本,其中150份为MPXV阳性(265份皮肤病变/水疱拭子和35份血清样本)。Bioperfectus试剂盒正确识别了294/300样本,显示敏感性为0.96(95% CI:0.93–0.99),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.96(95% CI:0.92–0.99),总体一致性为0.98(0.96–0.99)。VIASURE试剂盒正确检测了293/300样本,敏感性为0.95(0.92–0.99),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.95(95% CI:0.92–0.99),总体一致性为0.98(0.95–0.99)。Singuway试剂盒与参考方法的一致性最高,正确分类了295/300样本,敏感性为0.97(0.94–1.00),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.97(95% CI:0.94–1.00),总体一致性为0.98(0.97–1.00)。本研究表明,三种商业试剂盒与WHO协议相比具有良好的敏感性和特异性,以及强大的总体一致性。然而,为了进行真实世界的临床性能评估,还需要使用反映MPXV阳性样本真实情况的无偏倚临床样本集进行进一步分析。

title: Presumed transmission of avipoxvirus to human: Case report
abstract: Current cases of human monkeypox in the world have become a serious public health problem. According to the literature, avipoxvirus cannot be transmissible to human. The purpose of this study was to demonstrate that avipoxvirus transmission to human can occur in the poultry environment. In 2024, 1000 turkeys of 8 weeks old developed the cutaneous form of fowlpox. Three days after their vaccination on the farm by the veterinarian, who had abrasions on his left hand, skin lesions similar to those of smallpox and human monkeypox appeared on his respective hand. The clinical evolution of the veterinarian's hand lesions as well as tissue samples analyzed by histopathological examination and under transmission electron microscopy, were used to make the diagnosis. Over 35 days, the hand lesions progressed through the stages of papules, vesicles, pustules, ulcerations before to the crust, and desquamation. The histopathology of hand lesions samples revealed typical poxvirus changes in keratocytes and complete virus particles resembling fowlpoxvirus were observed using transmission electron microscopy. This study highlights that variola in human can be caused through compromised tegument in the presence of avipoxviruses. It is therefore critical to learn more about these enigmatic viruses, particularly their relationship with the host range.
journal: Revista Científica de la Facultad de Ciencias Veterinarias

title_zh: 禽痘病毒对人类的疑似传播:病例报告
source_body_en: Current cases of human monkeypox in the world have become a serious public health problem. According to the literature, avipoxvirus cannot be transmissible to human. abstract_zh: 目前全球范围内的人类猴痘病例已成为严重的公共卫生问题。根据文献,禽痘病毒无法传播给人类。本研究旨在证明在禽类环境中,禽痘病毒传播可能传播给人类。2024年,8周龄的1000只火鸡出现了禽痘的皮肤型病例。在兽医为这些火鸡接种禽痘病毒疫苗接种的三天后,该兽医左手出现有皮肤损伤,其双手的皮肤病变与天花和人类猴痘的病变相似。兽医手部病变的临床进化以及通过组织病理学检查和传播电子显微镜分析的组织样本,被用于做出诊断。在超过35天的时间里,手部病变经历了丘疹、水疱、脓疱、溃疡,最终形成痂皮并出现脱屑。手部病变样本的组织病理学检查显示了典型的痘病毒变化,通过传播电子显微镜观察到了与禽痘病毒相似的完整病毒颗粒。本研究强调了在存在禽痘病毒的情况下,人类可能通过受损的病毒包膜而感染天花。因此,深入了解这些神秘病毒,特别是它们与宿主范围的关系,至关重要。

title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.
journal: Recent Advances in Computer Science and Communications

analysis.methods: The proposed architecture integrates a Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11, applying Global Average Pooling and Max Average Pooling to input feature maps, and augments a dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements.
analysis.main_results: On the test set, HECA-YOLOv11 achieved 98.9% accuracy, 99% precision, 99.3% recall, and 99.1% F1-score, outperforming EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, YOLOv11s, SE-YOLOv11, and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all metrics.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces HECA-YOLOv11, a deep learning framework that integrates a Highly Efficient Channel Attention mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve real-time detection of mpox skin lesions. Using a four-class dataset augmented with spatial and pixel-domain enhancements, the model achieved 98.9% accuracy, 99% precision, 99.3% recall, and 99.1% F1-score on the test set, outperforming multiple baselines by over 5.1% across all metrics. Heatmap analysis via Grad-CAM confirmed lesion-focused attention, and a PyQt5 interface was developed to streamline clinical workflows. The authors argue this represents a major advancement toward reliable clinical decision support for early mpox screening and could accelerate public health responses. However, the abstract-only evidence lacks dataset size, external validation, and prospective clinical evaluation, constraining generalisability and evidence strength.

abstract_zh: 简介:全球 暴发 猴痘风险需要高效的诊断工具。目前的方法速度缓慢,并且难以区分相似的皮肤病变,而深度学习模型缺乏多类分类的准确性和可解释性。本研究旨在开发一种高性能、实时筛查工具,用于早期检测猴痘和类似病症。方法:本研究提出了一种增强的架构,将高效通道注意力(HECA)机制纳入 YOLOv11 中,以改进特征选择。HECA 对输入特征图执行全局平均池化 (GAP) 和最大平均池化 (MAP)。该研究利用空间变换和像素域增强,建立并增强了包含猴痘、麻疹、水痘和正常皮肤图像的四类数据集。梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 生成用于病变定位可视化的热图,而基于 PyQt5 的交互式诊断界面则简化了临床工作流程。结果:实验结果表明,与测试集上的现有方法(EfficientNet-v2-l、GoogLeNet、ResNet50、VGG19、MobileNetv2、DenseNet201 和 YOLOv11s)相比,所提出的模型具有优越的性能,具有增强的检测速度、准确度(98.9%)、精确度(99%)、召回率(99.3%)和 F1 分数(99.1%)。在所有评估指标中,HECA-YOLOv11 的性能均优于 SE-YOLOv11 和 ECA-YOLOv11 超过 5.1%。热图分析证实了该模型对病变区域的关注,与医学推理相一致。讨论:集成的注意力机制和可解释性技术有效地解决了自动皮肤病变检测的关键限制。高性能和低延迟标志着可靠临床决策支持的重大进步,对早期 暴发 遏制具有重要意义。结论:HECA-YOLOv11框架为早期猴痘筛查提供了高度准确和高效的工具。其标准化界面在加速公共卫生应对和改善新发传染病的全球控制方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Poxvirus antigenic proteins: from fundamental biology to translational applications
abstract: Abstract Poxviruses (family Poxviridae ) infect a wide range of human and animal hosts, causing diseases of substantial concern in both public health and veterinary medicine. Although smallpox was eradicated by global vaccination, the multicountry spread of mpox since 2022 and the continuing burden of capripox and parapox infections underscore the need for sustained poxvirus research and preparedness. Poxviruses have a complex virion architecture with two infectious forms, the intracellular mature virion (IMV) and extracellular enveloped virion (EEV), and large DNA genomes encoding more than 200 proteins, creating an antigenic landscape that complicates cross-genus comparison and application-oriented target prioritization. To define the biological basis for rational poxvirus antigen selection, we provide a cross-genus comparative synthesis of antigenic proteins in Orthopoxvirus , Capripoxvirus , and Parapoxvirus , integrating biological function, sequence conservation, antibody recognition, and published immunogenicity data. We delineate major antigen classes associated with IMV, EEV, and core structures and evaluate how their conserved and variable features influence immunodominance, neutralization, cross-protection, and serological discrimination. By relating these antigen-level features to translational application, this review establishes an antigen-centered framework that connects fundamental biology with practical relevance and provides a comparative basis for vaccine candidate selection, serological differentiation, and antibody-based intervention.

title_zh: 痘病毒抗原蛋白:从基础生物学到转化应用
source_body_en: Abstract Poxviruses (family Poxviridae ) infect a wide range of human and animal hosts, causing diseases of substantial concern in both public health and veterinary medicine. Although smallpox was eradicated by global vaccination, the multicountry spread of mpox since 2022 and the continuing burden of capripox and parapox infections underscore the need for sustained poxvirus research and preparedness. Poxviruses have a complex virion architecture with two infectious forms, the intracellular mature virion (IMV) and extracellular enveloped virion (EEV), and large DNA genomes encoding more than 200 proteins, creating an antigenic landscape that complicates cross-genus comparison and application-oriented target prioritization. To define the biological basis for rational poxvirus antigen selection, we provide a cross-genus comparative synthesis of antigenic proteins in Orthopoxvirus , Capripoxvirus , and Parapoxvirus , integrating biological function, sequence conservation, antibody recognition, and published immunogenicity data. We delineate major antigen classes associated with IMV, EEV, and core structures and evaluate how their conserved and variable features influence immunodominance, neutralization, cross-protection, and serological discrimination. By relating these antigen-level features to translational application, this review establishes an antigen-centered framework that connects fundamental biology with practical relevance and provides a comparative basis for vaccine candidate selection, serological differentiation, and antibody-based intervention.
abstract_zh: 摘要 痘病毒(痘病毒科)感染广泛的哺乳动物宿主,导致公共卫生和兽医医学领域广泛关注的疾病。尽管天花已被全球根除,但自2022年以来,猴痘病毒的多国传播以及牛痘病毒和副痘病毒持续感染的负担凸显了持续进行痘病毒研究和准备的必要性。痘病毒具有复杂的病毒颗粒结构,包含两种感染形式:细胞内成熟病毒(IMV)和细胞外包膜病毒(EEV),其大型DNA基因组编码超过200种蛋白,形成了复杂的抗原景观,使得跨属比较和以应用为导向的目标优先级制定变得困难。为了定义痘病毒抗原选择的生物学基础,我们提供了正痘病毒、牛痘病毒和副痘病毒抗原蛋白的跨属比较综合分析,整合了生物学功能、序列保守性、抗体识别以及已发表的免疫原性数据。我们界定了与IMV、EEV和核心结构相关的抗原类别,并评估了它们保守和变异特性如何影响免疫优势、中和作用、交叉保护和血清学区分。通过将这些抗原层面的特性与转化应用联系起来,本综述建立了一个以抗原为中心的框架,将基础生物学与实际应用联系起来,并为猴痘病毒候选疫苗的选择、血清学区分和基于抗体的干预提供了比较基础。

title: Psychologically Informed Machine Learning for Health Misinformation Detection and Propagation in Online Social Networks (OSNs)
abstract: Background: Health misinformation circulating through online social networks is associated with reduced adherence to public health guidance, vaccine hesitancy, and erosion of institutional trust. Many computational approaches still treat detection as text-only classification or model diffusion using network structure alone, with limited integration of psychological susceptibility and linguistic framing. Methods: This thesis develops a multi-strand framework combining machine learning, behavioural theory, network analysis, and linguistic profiling. Using Twitter datasets spanning COVID-19 and mpox, including the Monkeypox misinformation: Twitter dataset, hereafter referred to as the Monkeypox dataset, the detection strand benchmarks conventional and transformer-based baselines and then evaluates two theory-informed models: a multi-branch fusion architecture and an ELM-informed CNN–LSTM classifier. These models integrate semantic, rhetorical, stance, and TPBand ELM-informed features. The term mpox is used throughout this thesis in accordance with the World Health Organisation’s recommendation of November 2022. The former term is retained in the official title and shortened designation of the Monkeypox misinformation: Twitter dataset, as well as where it appears in original publication titles, direct quotations, file names, or variable names [314]. When engagement metadata are missing, the Cognitive Propagation Score (CPS) provides an auxiliary ranking signal for within-dataset comparison. The propagation strand develops susceptibility-aware influence measures, fits an ELM-augmented SIRMMM model with behaviour-modulated transmission, and introduces BERTopic-VP to prioritise themes using observed engagement where available and propensity-to-spread proxies otherwise. Results: Across datasets, the proposed detection models perform competitively against representative baselines and support interpretable analysis of cues associated with misinformation and elevated diffusion risk. Propagation results indicate that structural centrality does not consistently align with influence under proxy-grounded evaluation, and that behavioural covariates can shift outbreak timing and magnitude where behavioural variance is present, subject to identifiability constraints. BERTopic-VP prioritises coherent themes that are relatively rare yet highlyranked under engagement or proxy-based signals. Linguistic profiling shows that misinformation is more rhetorically marked and affectively loaded than factual content, with pandemic-specific framing differences. Conclusion: The thesis contributes a theoretically informed and empirically evaluated toolkit for health misinformation detection, characterisation, and prioritisation, supporting monitoring and risk-informed public health communication under uneven engagement availability.

title: Corona-Structured Magnetic Nanozymes Enable Dual-Mode Immunochromatographic Analysis for Flexible and Ultrasensitive Detection of Emerging Viruses
abstract: Abstract Real-time and highly sensitive monitoring of pathogens in environmental and host-derived samples is critical for controlling emerging and acute infectious diseases, yet remains technically challenging. Here, we report a multifunctional nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) that enables rapid, universal, and multiplex detection in different scenarios through visual readouts. We constructed a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme (CSMN) with a triple signal-amplification mechanism involving “magnetic enrichment-synergistic enhancement-multiple catalytic sites,” enabling efficient enrichment of trace pathogens in complex matrices and generation of dual visual outputs (colorimetric and catalytically enhanced signals) on ICA. The CSMN-based nanozyme ICA requires only 2 min of catalysis to achieve a ≥92.65-fold increase in sensitivity and a 100-fold expansion of the detection range. Based on this platform, dual-mode detection strategies were developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus. The direct mode enables rapid screening within 12 min, with detection limits as low as 19.4 and 22.5 pg/mL for the two targets, respectively. The enrichment mode enables ultrasensitive detection within 20 min, with detection ranges of 0.0012–1000 ng/mL and 0.0026–1000 ng/mL, respectively, while mitigating interference from the hook effect, making it suitable for detecting low-abundance targets in complex samples. The method demonstrated high accuracy and reliability across environmental and clinical samples, with a detection time approximately one-sixth that of qPCR and ELISA, indicating strong potential for infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the technical challenges in real-time and highly sensitive monitoring of pathogens, particularly emerging viruses, in environmental and host-derived samples to improve control of infectious diseases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development and testing of a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) for detecting mpox virus and other related viruses in various samples, including environmental and clinical specimens.
analysis.methods: The method utilized a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme (CSMN) with a triple signal-amplification mechanism, enabling efficient pathogen enrichment and dual visual outputs (colorimetric and catalytic signals) on ICA. The assay was tested for accuracy and reliability across different sample types.
analysis.main_results: The CSMN-based ICA achieved a ≥92.65-fold increase in sensitivity and a 100-fold expansion of the detection range within 2 min of catalysis. Dual-mode detection strategies were developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus, with detection limits as low as 19.4 and 22.5 pg/mL for the two targets, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the potential of their platform for rapid and ultrasensitive detection of emerging viruses, with the dual-mode strategy offering significant advantages over traditional methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this platform could enhance infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control by enabling faster and more sensitive detection of mpox virus and other related pathogens in complex samples.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its abstract-only evidence, but the method demonstrated high accuracy and reliability, with a detection time approximately one-sixth that of qPCR and ELISA, indicating strong potential for practical application.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) designed for rapid, sensitive, and ultrasensitive detection of emerging viruses, including mpox virus. The platform utilizes a triple signal-amplification mechanism to enhance detection capabilities in complex samples. The method was shown to achieve a significant increase in sensitivity and detection range compared to traditional techniques, with dual-mode strategies developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus. The assay offers a detection time of 12 minutes for direct mode and 20 minutes for enrichment mode, with low detection limits for mpox virus. The study highlights the potential of this technology for improving infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control, though the evidence is based solely on abstract data.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及开发和测试一种基于冠状结构磁性纳米酶的免疫层析检测方法(ICA),用于检测猴痘病毒及其他相关病毒在多种样本中的存在,包括环境样本和临床标本。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法利用了一种具有三重信号放大机制的冠状结构磁性纳米酶(CSMN),实现了病原体的有效富集,并在免疫层析试纸(ICA)上产生双可视化输出(比色信号和催化信号)。该检测方法在不同样本类型中测试了其准确性和可靠性。
elements_zh.main_results: 基于CSMN的ICA实现了在催化2分钟内灵敏度≥92.65倍的提升,并将检测范围扩展了100倍。开发了针对SARS-CoV-2和猴痘病毒的双模式检测策略,其对两个目标的检测限分别为19.4和22.5 pg/mL。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明了其平台在快速和超灵敏检测新出现病毒方面的潜力,双模式策略相较于传统方法具有显著优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,该平台可以通过在复杂样本中实现更快、更灵敏的检测,增强传染病监测和暴发的控制,包括猴痘病毒及其他相关病原体。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于仅基于摘要的证据,但所展示的方法具有高准确性和可靠性,检测时间约为qPCR和ELISA的六分之一,显示出在实际应用中的强大潜力。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development and testing of a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) for detecting mpox virus and other related viruses in various samples, including environmental and clinical specimens.
analysis_en.methods: The method utilized a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme (CSMN) with a triple signal-amplification mechanism, enabling efficient pathogen enrichment and dual visual outputs (colorimetric and catalytic signals) on ICA. The assay was tested for accuracy and reliability across different sample types.
analysis_en.main_results: The CSMN-based ICA achieved a ≥92.65-fold increase in sensitivity and a 100-fold expansion of the detection range within 2 min of catalysis. Dual-mode detection strategies were developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus, with detection limits as low as 19.4 and 22.5 pg/mL for the two targets, respectively.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the potential of their platform for rapid and ultrasensitive detection of emerging viruses, with the dual-mode strategy offering significant advantages over traditional methods.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this platform could enhance infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control by enabling faster and more sensitive detection of mpox virus and other related pathogens in complex samples.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its abstract-only evidence, but the method demonstrated high accuracy and reliability, with a detection time approximately one-sixth that of qPCR and ELISA, indicating strong potential for practical application.

title_zh: 冠状结构磁纳米酶使免疫层析分析能够实现对新兴病毒的双模式灵敏检测
source_body_en: Abstract Real-time and highly sensitive monitoring of pathogens in environmental and host-derived samples is critical for controlling emerging and acute infectious diseases, yet remains technically challenging. Here, we report a multifunctional nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) that enables rapid, universal, and multiplex detection in different scenarios through visual readouts. We constructed a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme (CSMN) with a triple signal-amplification mechanism involving “magnetic enrichment-synergistic enhancement-multiple catalytic sites,” enabling efficient enrichment of trace pathogens in complex matrices and generation of dual visual outputs (colorimetric and catalytically enhanced signals) on ICA. The CSMN-based nanozyme ICA requires only 2 min of catalysis to achieve a ≥92.65-fold increase in sensitivity and a 100-fold expansion of the detection range. Based on this platform, dual-mode detection strategies were developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus. The direct mode enables rapid screening within 12 min, with detection limits as low as 19.4 and 22.5 pg/mL for the two targets, respectively. The enrichment mode enables ultrasensitive detection within 20 min, with detection ranges of 0.0012–1000 ng/mL and 0.0026–1000 ng/mL, respectively, while mitigating interference from the hook effect, making it suitable for detecting low-abundance targets in complex samples. The method demonstrated high accuracy and reliability across environmental and clinical samples, with a detection time approximately one-sixth that of qPCR and ELISA, indicating strong potential for infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及开发和测试一种基于冠状结构磁性纳米酶的免疫层析检测方法(ICA),用于检测猴痘病毒及其他相关病毒在多种样本中的存在,包括环境样本和临床标本。
analysis_zh.methods: 该方法利用了一种具有三重信号放大机制的冠状结构磁性纳米酶(CSMN),实现了病原体的有效富集,并在免疫层析试纸(ICA)上产生双可视化输出(比色信号和催化信号)。该检测方法在不同样本类型中测试了其准确性和可靠性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 基于CSMN的ICA实现了在催化2分钟内灵敏度≥92.65倍的提升,并将检测范围扩展了100倍。开发了针对SARS-CoV-2和猴痘病毒的双模式检测策略,其对两个目标的检测限分别为19.4和22.5 pg/mL。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明了其平台在快速和超灵敏检测新出现病毒方面的潜力,双模式策略相较于传统方法具有显著优势。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,该平台可以通过在复杂样本中实现更快、更灵敏的检测,增强传染病监测和暴发的控制,包括猴痘病毒及其他相关病原体。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于仅基于摘要的证据,但所展示的方法具有高准确性和可靠性,检测时间约为qPCR和ELISA的六分之一,显示出在实际应用中的强大潜力。
